description: Fetch one node from the ICIJ Offshore Leaks Database by its node_id -- full details (name, jurisdiction, status, incorporation/struck-off dates, registered agent) plus every linked officer, intermediary, entity or address, with the relationship role ("shareholder of", "registered address", "intermediary of") and which ICIJ leak each link comes from. Use after offshore_search returns a node_id. Works for any node type (entity, officer, intermediary, address, other) -- officers and intermediaries show the entities they are linked to, and entities show their officers/intermediaries/addresses.

limit.description: Max linked relationships to return (default 50, max 200).

node_id.description: The node_id returned by offshore_search, e.g. "10206223".

name: offshore_entity
title: Offshore Entity
